name: Skeleton
structurePatterns: placeholder blocks mirror the real content structure (avatar circle, title lines, body lines)
blocks are subtle-surface rounded rectangles; a subtle shimmer can sweep across
a list skeleton = repeated rows of a leading square + two text lines
a card skeleton = header block + 2-3 body lines; profile = avatar circle + two centered lines
usageHints: use when the loading structure is known; prefer it over a blank spinner for content areas
mirror real content, do not use decorative random bars
individual blocks are hidden from the accessibility tree; container marks busy state
doNotInvent: no mixing loaded copy with unrelated skeleton blocks
no full-screen skeleton reset on background refresh
